description: This Java class 'LoanStatusMapper' provides utility methods to determine the status of a loan based on its status ID. It encapsulates logic for identifying various loan states like pending approval, awaiting disbursal, open, withdrawn by client, rejected, closed, and overpaid.

classes.name: LoanStatusMapper
classes.description: A class that maps a loan's status ID to boolean indicators of specific loan states.

methods.name: LoanStatusMapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the mapper with a specific status ID.

methods.name: isPendingApproval
methods.description: Checks if the loan status ID indicates pending approval (ID 100).

methods.name: isAwaitingDisbursal
methods.description: Checks if the status ID indicates awaiting disbursal (ID 200).

methods.name: isOpen
methods.description: Checks if the loan is currently open (ID 300).

methods.name: isWithdrawnByClient
methods.description: Checks if the loan has been withdrawn by the client (ID 400).

methods.name: isRejected
methods.description: Checks if the loan has been rejected (ID 500).

methods.name: isClosed
methods.description: Determines if the loan is closed, either by reaching ID 600, being withdrawn, or rejected.

methods.name: isOverpaid
methods.description: Checks if the loan is overpaid (ID 700).
